description: Desktop ATX +3.3V main rail. Enabled by the PSU when PS_ON# is pulled low by the motherboard. PWR_OK must assert before the CPU reset is released.
psu_signal_notes: Absent until PS_ON# is asserted. If absent with PS_ON# low, the PSU is the prime suspect; if absent with PS_ON# high, the motherboard is not asserting PS_ON#.
